chapter_seo_title: Immortal Fortunes Assembly: Ji Ning's Ruthless Strategy Secures a Spot in the Top Six
chapter_meta_description: The pressure of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly cracks Shaoyan Xuan's composure, leading to a swift and brutal defeat at Ji Ning's hands. Witness the final six contenders emerge in this intense chapter of Desolate Era.
og_title: Desolate Era Chapter 344: A Dao-Heart Shattered
og_description: One cultivator's ambition becomes his downfall as the top six of the Grand Xia's greatest tournament are decided. A pivotal moment of psychological warfare.
twitter_title: Crushing Victory: Ji Ning Punishes an Unstable Dao-Heart!
twitter_description: Shaoyan Xuan's desperation leads to a reckless mistake, giving Ji Ning an opening he ruthlessly exploits. See who makes the cut for the top six!

lore_anchors.definition: A high-level Immortal who has transcended the ordinary Celestial Immortal stage, possessing vast power and insight.
A supreme being who has mastered a Heavenly Dao, standing at the very peak of the power structure within the Three Realms.
A legendary divine ability that allows Ji Ning to weaponize his hands, granting them immense piercing and crushing power.
A powerful battle array named after the mythical sage Fuxi, allowing the user to control space and launch unpredictable attacks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Shaoyan Xuan lose so badly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He lost his composure. Driven by desperation to win and impress a Daofather, he made a tactical error by lowering his own strength at a critical moment, which Ji Ning immediately exploited.
It is a cultivator's mental and spiritual core—their willpower, clarity, and emotional control. A shaky Dao-heart leads to poor decisions under pressure.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is Fuxi in the formation's name?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Fuxi is a legendary Chinese culture hero and one of the Three Sovereigns, credited with creating the I Ching and the Eight Trigrams.
